examples.question: Which guidelines applied to the purchasing team at the start of the year?

functions.name: guidelines_in_effect

params.name: unit
params.summary: The unit whose positions own the processes.

params.name: date
params.summary: The day the guideline must be effective on.

functions.query:
MATCH (g:`ops:Guideline`)-[:`ops:governs`]->(:`ops:Process`)-[:`ops:owned_by`]->(:`org:Position`)-[:`org:in_unit`]->(u:`org:OrgUnit`) WHERE ((u.id = $unit) AND (g.effective_from <= $date))
RETURN DISTINCT g.title AS guideline, g.effective_from AS effective_from ORDER BY effective_from DESC, guideline
functions.source_query:
MATCH (g:Guideline)-[:governs]->(:Process)-[:owned_by]->(:Position)-[:in_unit]->(u:OrgUnit)
WHERE u.id = $unit AND g.effective_from <= $date
RETURN DISTINCT g.title AS guideline, g.effective_from AS effective_from
ORDER BY effective_from DESC, guideline
functions.summary: Guidelines that apply on a date to the processes owned from a unit.
functions.use_when: Which rules or policies govern the work of a department or team on a given day.

examples.question: Who works in the infrastructure department, including its teams?

functions.name: members_of_unit
functions.query:
MATCH (p:`ppl:Person`)-[:`org:holds`]->(q:`org:Position`)-[:`org:in_unit`]->(u:`org:OrgUnit`)-[:`org:part_of`*0..5]->(d:`org:OrgUnit`) WHERE (d.id = $unit)
RETURN p.name AS person, q.title AS position, u.name AS unit ORDER BY unit, person

returns.summary: The unit the position belongs to.

functions.source_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:holds]->(q:Position)-[:in_unit]->(u:OrgUnit)-[:part_of*0..5]->(d:OrgUnit)
WHERE d.id = $unit
RETURN p.name AS person, q.title AS position, u.name AS unit
ORDER BY unit, person
functions.summary: People holding a position in a unit or in any unit below it.
functions.use_when: Who works in a department or team, including its sub-units; headcount of a unit.

examples.question: Who in the finance department has not done the required safety training?

functions.name: missing_required_trainings

params.name: unit
params.summary: The unit whose position holders are checked.

functions.query:
MATCH (p:`ppl:Person`)-[:`org:holds`]->(q:`org:Position`)-[:`org:in_unit`]->(u:`org:OrgUnit`), (t:`ops:Training`)-[:`ops:required_for`]->(q) WHERE ((u.id = $unit) AND (NOT (p)-[:`ops:completed`]->(t)))
RETURN p.name AS person, t.title AS training ORDER BY person, training

returns.summary: Title of the training they still have to complete.

functions.source_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:holds]->(q:Position)-[:in_unit]->(u:OrgUnit),
      (t:Training)-[:required_for]->(q)
WHERE u.id = $unit AND NOT (p)-[:completed]->(t)
RETURN p.name AS person, t.title AS training
ORDER BY person, training
functions.summary: Trainings that holders of positions in a unit have not completed yet.
functions.use_when: Compliance gaps, who still has to complete a required training in a department or team.

examples.question: Who has a mail address at the example domain?

functions.name: people_by_email_text

params.name: text
params.summary: The text to look for in the address.

functions.query:
MATCH (p:`ppl:Person`) WHERE (p.work_email CONTAINS $text)
RETURN p.name AS person, p.work_email AS email ORDER BY person
functions.source_query:
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.work_email CONTAINS $text
RETURN p.name AS person, p.work_email AS email
ORDER BY person
functions.summary: People whose work email contains a text.
functions.use_when: Find a person from part of an email address or a mail domain.

examples.question: Who completed the safety or the security training this year?

functions.name: training_completions

params.name: titles
params.summary: Titles of the trainings to include.

params.name: since
params.summary: Only completions on or after this date.

functions.query:
MATCH (p:`ppl:Person`)-[c:`ops:completed`]->(t:`ops:Training`) WHERE ((t.title IN $titles) AND (c.on >= $since))
RETURN p.name AS person, t.title AS training, c.on AS completed_on ORDER BY completed_on, person
functions.source_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[c:completed]->(t:Training)
WHERE t.title IN $titles AND c.on >= $since
RETURN p.name AS person, t.title AS training, c.on AS completed_on
ORDER BY completed_on, person
functions.summary: Who completed which of the given trainings since a date.
functions.use_when: Completion records of named trainings, certificates earned in a period.

examples.question: Who is directly in the support team?

functions.name: unit_members
functions.query:
MATCH (p:`ppl:Person`)-[:`org:holds`]->(q:`org:Position`)-[:`org:in_unit`]->(u:`org:OrgUnit`) WHERE (u.id = $unit)
RETURN p.name AS person, q.title AS position ORDER BY person
functions.source_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:holds]->(q:Position)-[:in_unit]->(u:OrgUnit)
WHERE u.id = $unit
RETURN p.name AS person, q.title AS position
ORDER BY person
functions.summary: People holding a position directly in a unit.
functions.use_when: Who sits in exactly this unit, without its sub-units. Superseded by members_of_unit.

examples.question: Which positions are still open in the sales department?

functions.name: vacant_positions

params.name: unit
params.summary: The unit to search, including its sub-units.

functions.query:
MATCH (q:`org:Position`)-[:`org:in_unit`]->(u:`org:OrgUnit`)-[:`org:part_of`*0..5]->(d:`org:OrgUnit`) WHERE ((d.id = $unit) AND (NOT (:`ppl:Person`)-[:`org:holds`]->(q)))
RETURN q.title AS position, u.name AS unit ORDER BY unit, position

returns.summary: The unit the position belongs to.

functions.source_query:
MATCH (q:Position)-[:in_unit]->(u:OrgUnit)-[:part_of*0..5]->(d:OrgUnit)
WHERE d.id = $unit AND NOT (:Person)-[:holds]->(q)
RETURN q.title AS position, u.name AS unit
ORDER BY unit, position
functions.summary: Positions in a unit or below it that nobody holds.
functions.use_when: Open or unfilled positions of a department or team, hiring needs.
